item: Nucleus-resolved parvalbumin composition in the Wwox-deletion mouse (snRNA matrices of GSE158684 or PV immunostaining in the neuron-targeted deletion)
verdict: PARTIAL (nucleus-level data read 2026-10-31 and independently recomputed 2026-11-01: undecidable at one pooled library per genotype; raw reads not public)
decisive_datum: whether the lower Pvalb transcript means fewer PV cells, less Pvalb per cell or delayed maturation, at the level of animals
queries_and_sources: sources: GSE158684 (one Cell Ranger-called pool per arm, 3182 and 2920 nuclei, library and animal index absent, paper n = 1 per arm; Pvalb 70 against 37 UMI, 12 to 19 PV-class nuclei per arm); the eight snRNA SRA experiments (SRX9206272 to 79) carry status hup (not public) on 2026-10-31, so re-aggregation by library is not executable; identity read in the Brain 2021 paper (Synapsin-Cre against a Cre-only control; receipt FTR-20261101-33914858-01, targeted passages) in gse158684_identity_it14_p1a_20261101; classification recomputed in gse158684_verify_it14_p1b_20261101
trigger_to_reopen: any of: (a) the eight snRNA SRA experiments leave hup and at least 3 independent libraries per arm are shown by barcode overlap with at least about 50 PV-class nuclei per arm recoverable; (b) a library or animal index for GSE158684 is deposited; (c) per-animal PV immunostaining counts in the neuron-targeted deletion against Cre-only controls, at least 3 animals per arm; (d) an independent dataset of the neuron-targeted deletion with at least 3 animals per arm and a PV-enriched capture. An absence of PV change in GSE158684 is not evidence of no change
owner_or_route: data holders or GEO; nothing sent

item: Cause of the fall of Wwox UMI in glial nuclei of the neuron-targeted deletion pool (GSE158684)
decisive_datum: whether the glial Wwox loss is a genotype effect (Cre activity beyond neurons, or a non-cell-autonomous change in a seizing brain) or a pool-level or class-calling artefact
queries_and_sources: sources: independent recompute (gse158684_verify_it14_p1b_20261101) and identity table (gse158684_identity_it14_p1a_20261101): Wwox UMI per 1e4 UMI falls 44-fold in oligodendrocyte-class and 20-fold in astrocyte-class nuclei against 7 to 9-fold in neurons, ambient neuronal RNA explains at most about a quarter of the control glial signal; the paper reports WWOX protein intact in CC1-positive oligodendrocytes (immunofluorescence, not quantified); no tdTomato reporter readout was seen in the text read
trigger_to_reopen: a reporter readout or per-cell-type WWOX protein in the Synapsin-Cre deletion, or per-library snRNA data, or an independent snRNA dataset of the same deletion
owner_or_route: literature watch and data holders; nothing sent
